ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: A section of curved long pipe is additionally connected to the water outlet of the metal inner tank of an electric water heater. When the electric water heater leaks electricity and the grounding wire fails, it can form an “electricity-proof wall” to ensure human safety. As shown in the figure, when the water heater leaks electricity and the grounding wire fails, the voltage between its metal inner tank and the earth is 220 V. Since the water in the curved long pipe has resistance (abbreviated as “electricity-isolating resistance”), the voltage across the human body is not higher than 12 V. Which of the following statements is correct ( )

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: At the top of the figure is an electric water heater labeled “220 V”; below it there is a water outlet structure; on the right side there is a person using water; on the left side there is a grounding symbol and a failure/disconnection mark, indicating that when the water heater leaks electricity and the grounding wire fails, the person and the water outlet path may form a current path to the earth. Then reason: When leakage occurs, the metal inner tank is electrified; the current needs to pass through the resistive water in the outlet pipe or the curved long pipe, namely the “electricity-isolating resistance”, then through the human body in contact with the water, namely the “human body resistance”, and finally reach the earth. Therefore the “electricity-isolating resistance” and the “human body resistance” are in the same current path and are in a series relationship. The stem gives that the voltage between the metal inner tank and the earth is 220 V, while the voltage across the human body is not higher than 12 V. In a series circuit, voltage is distributed according to the magnitude of resistance. The human body only gets a very small voltage, indicating that the human body resistance is smaller; the electricity-isolating resistance bears most of the voltage, indicating that the electricity-isolating resistance is larger. Therefore the “electricity-isolating resistance” is greater than the “human body resistance”, and the two are connected in series.
